title: One Box, Two Characters, and the First Thing You Can Refuse
label: ch:zh-negation
canDo: I can write 口 and 日 -- the second being the first with one bar added -- and I can disagree in Mandarin by putting 不 in front of a word I already know, because Mandarin has no standalone word for no.

payoff.summary: The first exchange in the book that contains a disagreement -- a greeting, a question, and a refusal built by negating a word the reader has had since the opening lesson.
